residual_risks: The full Miles 1971 sphere tessellations article was unavailable; a directly covering formula could exist.
The full Arbeiter–Zähle 1994 spherical mosaic article was not read.

General Blaschke–Petkantschin shape/size formulas are a known implication route; the present contribution is their explicit Voronoi-area pushforward and maximum-statistic evaluation, not a new general principle.
Literature and repository searches are not mathematical proof of uniqueness.

value.rationale: The joint law solves a natural missing geometric statistic for the minimal nontrivial spherical Voronoi tessellation. Previously reported individual marginals and pair covariance do not determine whether one area dominates the entire partition. The full bivariate density determines any area-balance functional, while the explicit maximum CDF, mean, threshold and two sharp endpoint laws quantify worst-cell spatial imbalance. Its scope is mathematically motivated and not an arbitrary numerical slice.
